system.description:
Tridactyls are members of a diminutive reptilian race that is found throughout the galaxy. The Tridactyl race is shrouded in mystery. Even the name "Tridactyl" is a descriptive term first applied to them by Republic scientists because of their three-fingered hands. The Tridactyls have no apparent knowledge of their homeworld, heritage or even a name for themselves (or at least none that they share with outsiders).

They first appeared in known space several millennia ago in small numbers, and still live in isolated communities where they stay away from the galactic mainstream. Their reclusiveness has lead to many myths, rumors and wild speculation. The Tridactyls are often mistaken for Lanniks, or even Whills, although they are a distinct Species.

The Tridactyls are naturally talented with The Force. While they are not all Force-sensitive (contrary to common belief), Force Sensitivity is much more common in Tridactyls than in others and they tend to be very powerful Force-users.
